line: 5 checks flagged, 0 notes. The history looks staged. Read the lines before you decide.

checks.name: Clock
checks.headline: The dates don't add up.
evidence: First commit 2019-03-24; repository created on GitHub 2026-04-20 (7.1 years later); account created 2019-03-22.
Author and committer dates differ on 477 of 477 commits (by up to 4.0 h).
The history begins 1 day after the account was created, then waits 7.1 years before the repository appears on GitHub.
Nearly every commit carries a committer date a few hours after its author date. Plain commits normally carry the same time twice; rebases change it, but not uniformly across the whole history.

checks.name: Metronome
checks.headline: A schedule, not a person.
evidence: That curve is flat (variation 1%). Real projects are lumpy: releases, holidays, lost interest.
Typical gap between commits: 5.8 days (half of all gaps within ±0.1 days of that).
Commits land on a near-fixed interval. Humans don't; schedulers do.

checks.name: Names
checks.headline: Names and addresses don't belong together.
evidence: Ines Moreau (40 commits) commits as harperwalsh1988@example.com.
Tomas Reyes (29 commits) commits as quinnmercer0412@example.com.
Lena Brandt (20 commits) commits as averycollins77@example.com.
3 of 3 authors commit from an address that reads like a different person's name (19% of commits). Nicknames and initials are not counted.

checks.name: Masks
checks.headline: The owner commits under another name.
evidence: Marcus Vell (388 commits) commits with the repository owner's own GitHub address (user 1000001, under the earlier login "quietgrove"), and that is not the owner's name.

checks.name: Crowd
checks.headline: Nothing to read.
evidence: A local demo has no forks, pull requests or stars, so this check has nothing to score.

checks.name: Claims
checks.headline: The README promises more than the code does.
evidence: The README says money moves ("reserve backstop deploys capital into pools whose depth falls below a floor."), but 1 on-chain source file and 1 client file contain no transfer, CPI or transaction-sending call.
The program id in programs/halcyon/src/lib.rs is Fg6PaFpo…, the placeholder from Anchor's project template. Nothing was ever deployed under it by this project.
The README says "The risk engine and the on-chain program are implemented." and also "The on-chain program is drawn dashed because it is not implemented yet.".
